card.name: Inside the word inducer
card.fires_on: The word induce and its forms (induced, inducing, inducers), including the first pieces of the word when it is split, mostly in enzyme and drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Split inducer
modes.description: The first pieces of inducer when the word is broken up, as in CYP enzyme inducers.
